heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 426e and 426f to 426h–1 of this title, the following definitions apply:

tree.heading: Erosion control program
tree.text: The term “erosion control program” means the national shoreline erosion control development and demonstration program established under this section.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Army.

tree.heading: Separable element
tree.text: The term “separable element” has the meaning provided by section 2213(f) of this title.

tree.heading: Shore
tree.text: The term “shore” includes each shoreline of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, the Gulf of Mexico, the Great Lakes, and lakes, estuaries, and bays directly connected therewith.

tree.heading: Shore protection project
tree.text: The term “shore protection project” includes a project for beach nourishment, including the replacement of sand.

ancestors.heading: PROTECTION OF NAVIGABLE WATERS AND OF HARBOR AND RIVER IMPROVEMENTS GENERALLY
